summary: The initial step in inventory management involves creating item masters in the system. This process includes creating new items, viewing existing items, and editing item details. Items can include various assets like tables, chairs, pens, pencils, and chalk.
business_rules: All item data for the institute or organization must be recorded in the item masters section.
important_notes: Creating item masters is a foundational step for effective inventory management.
questions: How do I manage items in the ERP inventory?
What is the process for adding new items to the inventory?
Where can I see a list of all existing inventory items?
